scripts.build: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/ui build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server build && pnpm --filter coworker build && pnpm --filter @drawless/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/shared test && pnpm --filter @drawless/server test && pnpm --filter coworker test && pnpm --filter @drawless/web test:unit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/server typecheck && pnpm --filter coworker typecheck && pnpm --filter @drawless/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @drawless/server smoke && pnpm --filter @drawless/server smoke:coworker-control && pnpm smoke:web
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/ui build && node scripts/dev-stack.mjs
scripts.dev:coworker:stack: pnpm --filter @drawless/shared build && pnpm --filter @drawless/ui build && node scripts/dev-stack.mjs --coworker
